title: David Among the Philistines

questions.question: Why did David decide to go to the land of the Philistines?
options: To escape Saul, thinking he would one day perish by Saul’s hand
questions.correctAnswer: To escape Saul, thinking he would one day perish by Saul’s hand
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:1 (ESV): “Then David said in his heart, ‘Now I shall perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape to the land of the Philistines.’”

questions.question: Which Philistine king did David go to?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:2 (ESV): “...David... went over... to Achish... king of Gath.”

questions.question: What city did Achish give David?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:6 (ESV): “So Achish gave him Ziklag that day.”

questions.question: Who did David actually raid while living there?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:8 (ESV): “Now David and his men went up and made raids against the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites...”

questions.question: Who did David tell Achish he was raiding?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:10 (ESV): “And David would say, ‘Against the Negeb of Judah...’”

questions.question: How long did David live in the country of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:7 (ESV): "The number of days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a year and four months."

questions.question: Why did David leave no man or woman alive in the raids?
options: Lest they should tell on him to Achish
questions.correctAnswer: Lest they should tell on him to Achish
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:11 (ESV): "...lest they should tell about us and say, 'So did David.'"

questions.question: Did Saul continue to seek David after he went to Gath?
options: No, he sought him no more
questions.correctAnswer: No, he sought him no more
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:4 (ESV): "And when it was told Saul that David had fled to Gath, he sought him no more."

questions.question: Achish trusted David, believing he had made himself an utter ______ to his people Israel.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:12 (ESV): "...He has made himself an utter stench to his people Israel; therefore he shall be my servant always."

questions.question: How many warriors were with David when he went to Achish?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:2 (ESV): "...he and the six hundred men who were with him..."

questions.question: What region is Ziklag associated with historically in this text?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:6 (ESV): "...therefore Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah to this day."

questions.question: Who was Achish the son of?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:2 (ESV): "...Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath."

questions.question: Besides the Negeb of Judah, where else did David claim to raid?
options: Negeb of the Jerahmeelites and the Kenites
questions.correctAnswer: Negeb of the Jerahmeelites and the Kenites
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:10 (ESV): "...or against the Negeb of the Jerahmeelites, or against the Negeb of the Kenites."

questions.question: What livestock did David take from the raids?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:9 (ESV): "...and took away the sheep, the oxen, the donkeys, the camels, and the garments..."

questions.question: Why did David ask for a place in the country towns?
options: Why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?
questions.correctAnswer: Why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 27:5 (ESV): "...For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?"

key_verse_text: Then David said in his heart, “Now I shall perish one day by the hand of Saul...” (ESV)
